entities.summary: Sui Ishida (b. 1986-12-28, Fukuoka Prefecture) was a musician or composer of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Fukuoka Prefecture and Japan. Known in the fields of japan, painters & sculptors, asia.
